A MOMENT FOR YOURSELF

Your femininity.
On your terms.

A quiet morning, getting ready for yourself, a detail you choose to keep close. Annys Le´ Rose is taking shape around those personal moments.

  • Room to be yourself.

    Soft, bold, quiet or expressive. Your way of feeling feminine does not need to fit an ideal.

  • Begin with intimates.

    Intimates are at the heart. Scent and a touch of gloss accompany a considered selection to explore on your terms.

  • Five days. Once a year.

    Édition 05 is our proposed annual scent-and-gloss ritual. Dates remain to be announced; for now, its concepts can be explored.
